result:
Lo siento, no tengo acceso a información en tiempo real sobre horarios de transporte público, ni puedo rastrear la ubicación de autobuses específicos.

Para obtener esa información, te recomiendo:

1.  **Usar una aplicación de transporte:** Aplicaciones como Google Maps, Moovit o la aplicación oficial de transporte de tu ciudad suelen mostrar los horarios en tiempo real.
2.  **Consultar el sitio web oficial:** Busca la página de la empresa de transporte de tu localidad.
3.  **Mirar el panel en la parada:** Muchas paradas modernas tienen pantallas digitales que indican el tiempo de llegada.

function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL and retrieves the data. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The URL to send the GET request to, formatted as 'https://api.example.com/data'.

headers.description: Optional dictionary of HTTP headers to send with the request.

Content-Type.description: The Media type of the resource, e.g., 'application/json'.

User-Agent.description: The user agent string of the software that is acting on behalf of the user.

timeout.description: The maximum time to wait for a response from the server in seconds. This is a float type value.

params.description: Optional dictionary containing the GET request parameters.

auth.description: Optional tuple for HTTP authentication, formatted as ('username', 'password').

cert.description: Optional string specifying a cert file or key for SSL.

cookies.description: Optional dictionary of cookies to send with the request.

proxies.description: Optional dictionary of proxies to use for the request, e.g., {'http': 'http://10.10.1.10:3128', 'https': 'https://10.10.1.11:1080'}.

http.description: HTTP proxy URL to use for requests.

https.description: HTTPS proxy URL to use for requests.

stream.description: Whether to stream the download of the response.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate.
